scope: Development falsification of a known codec composition on fixed-length unbiased random walks. Not FeLoG replication, FeeST training, held-out validation, latency, energy, or novelty.
sampler: Canonical dense trainer IDs from sorted original node IDs; undirected sorted-neighbor CSR; uniformly random start node and uniform neighbor at each step. No training or shrinking frontier. Round 1 profiles; rounds 2–5 evaluate frozen ranks/hot IDs.
rank_tie_break: descending round-1 frequency, ascending dense trainer ID; include zero-frequency nodes
fabc_selection: Corrected explicit marginal-add interpretation: start k=0; add next frequency rank while p[k]-c >= 0.1*g(k), c=1/L+1/32. Also report global-last-passing-add interpretation. Candidate comparison uses the smaller observed-byte FaBC variant as an oracle sensitivity control, not a deployable selector.
formats: FaBC per-sequence bitmaps and uint32 tail
FaBC per-sequence bitmaps and fixed-width tail
frame: Codec implementation fixes and reports framing. FaBC stores hot IDs per sequence; sequence tail offsets required for parallel reconstruction; varint stores per-sequence byte offsets. Rank-to-trainer uint32 dictionary charged once per four evaluation rounds. Common original-ID-to-dense mapping excluded for every arm because trainer uses dense IDs.
roundtrip: Serialize and decode every evaluation corpus for every codec; exact trainer-ID equality required. Hash walk arrays and encoded payloads.
gate: Only proceed to GPU work if both graphs have median across seeds of varint total/payload-FaBC <=0.85 AND varint total/best packed control <=0.90, with all round trips exact. Total includes one rank dictionary per seed and four rounds. Also report optimistic resident-dictionary ratios: failure there cannot be repaired by amortizing the dictionary.
limitations: Finite sampled walks, not ten walks per node
Profile estimated from a small first round; unseen nodes tie by trainer ID
No real FeeST activity feedback or synchronization
No final held-out graph downloaded or examined
All graphs and seeds are development, and may not resemble author skew
No codec implementation timing used as a systems claim
